verdict.rationale: Grok documents a set of built-in connectors maintained by xAI, each connected once via OAuth. Documented connectors include Gmail/Google Calendar, Google Drive, Microsoft Teams and Salesforce, and users can also add custom MCP connectors for other tools. That covers the core of finding third-party integrations and adding them to the assistant. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace UI, any third-party-published app ecosystem beyond the xAI-maintained catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
